name: report_issued
description: Sent to each contact with parental responsibility when a pupil's report to parents is issued.
subject: {report_name} for {pupil_name}
body: {pupil_first_name}'s {report_name} is ready. You can read it in the parent portal under Reports, and a copy is below.
If you have any questions, please contact {pupil_first_name}'s form tutor{tutor_line}.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.pupil_first_name: The pupil's preferred or first name
placeholders.tutor_line: The tutor's name and e-mail in brackets, or nothing
